schemes.name: Annual Grants to Divisional / District Cricket Associations
schemes.description: Annual grant passed on by MPCA to Divisions for their Districts, and a portion retained by the Division for common expenses.
conditions: Grant ceiling assessed against previous 2-3 years spending pattern; if <80%, average amount paid.
Grant forfeited if not claimed within 12 months of previous FY closure.
Submission of comprehensive documents for both Division and Districts is mandatory.
required_documents: Auditor's Report & Audited Statement of Accounts for preceding FY
List of members as on AGM date (attested)
Copy of documents submitted to Registrar of Firms & Societies
Bank statement showing payment of last grant to Districts

schemes.name: Share to Divisions out of Net Revenue from ODI / T20
schemes.description: A percentage of net revenue from each International Match hosted by MPCA is shared with Divisions.
conditions: Applicable for ODI & T20 matches; case-to-case basis for Test Matches.
70% of surplus share MUST be utilized for earmarked investments (FDs for District incentive/junior rewards) or infrastructure development.
30% can be used for other common Division expenditures.
Internal distribution within 70% is at Division's discretion, payable after MPCA approval.
Entitlement to next share is contingent on receipt of all prior required documents chronologically.
required_documents: Copies of Fixed Deposit instruments for earmarked investments
Written norms for District Incentive Scheme & Junior Player Rewards
CA-certified Utilization Certificate for surplus spent (infrastructure & common expenditure)

schemes.name: Inter-School Tournament Reimbursement
schemes.description: Reimbursement for hosting Inter-School tournaments within a Division.
conditions: Scheme covers match balls, ground rent (if any), and trophies within the ₹5,000/day grant.
Umpires/scorers get additional ₹150 conveyance if ground is far.
Only local schools invited; players return home daily. No hotel/food costs sanctioned.
Entry fee collection must be declared in the claim.
Maximum 12 schools at Div HQ / 8 at District.

schemes.name: Inter-District Tournament Reimbursement
schemes.description: Reimbursement for hosting Inter-District tournaments within a Division.
conditions: Max 40 pax for food/tea.
Accommodation & Dinner limited to outstation teams only.
If ground is > 10 km from city, hotel/dinner cost is allowed.
Coach/manager/trainer fees absorbed within per-day ceiling.
If Division has >= 5 Districts, Rank 1 & Rank 2 prizes paid; <= 4 Districts, only Rank 1 prize paid.
Divisional HQ team excluded from prize money; if HQ wins, finalist is Rank 1, better semi-finalist is Rank 2.
Per-day ceiling: ~₹28,000 (one team outstation) / ~₹39,000 (both teams outstation) per match-day.
required_documents: Claim submitted only on completion of tournament.
Photocopy of tickets for visiting team travel.

schemes.name: Inter-Divisional Tournament — Travel
schemes.description: Reimbursement for travel costs of Divisional teams participating in Inter-Divisional tournaments.

heads.label: Inter-city travel — III-tier AC rail (to & fro)

conditions: Team strength max 18 pax (15 players + coach + manager + trainer).
Coach & trainer must be MPCA empanelled.
Alternate mode of travel requires PRIOR MPCA approval.
Misc. journey expense covers refreshments en-route.
Joining travel only for players actually joining the team; not for camp-only players.
Tatkal/cancellation charges allowed on merits of the circumstance.
Out-of-MP senior guest player travel/lodging/boarding NOT reimbursed.
Claim submitted only on completion of the tournament.
Accommodation, food, local conveyance at venue, umpire/scorer fees etc. borne by the HOST Division.
required_documents: Match/journey dates, team strength, mode/category of journey

schemes.name: Inter-Divisional Tournament — Hosting
schemes.description: Reimbursement for hosting Inter-Divisional tournaments.

heads.label: Accommodation — rooms (visiting team, host district players, officials)
Coach honorarium — non-match days / one day before
Trainer honorarium — non-match days / one day before
Manager honorarium — non-match day or one day before
heads.rate_display: ₹750 / non-match day or one day before

heads.label: Man of the Match — Limited-overs / T20 match
Man of the Match — Multi-day match
Team prize — WINNER (Multi-day, player + staff pool)
Team prize — RUNNER-UP (Multi-day, player + staff pool)
Team prize — WINNER (Ltd-overs / T20, player + staff pool)
Team prize — RUNNER-UP (Ltd-overs / T20, player + staff pool)

conditions: Team strength 18–20 players (7–8 outstation typical).
Camp days included within Coach/Trainer honorarium ceilings.
Coach & trainer from MPCA empanelled list only.
Match balls provided by MPCA in kind.
Medical allowed at actual cost.
Team prize money distribution: Playing XI 75% (pro-rata), non-playing 15%, coach 4%, other staff 6%.
TDS deducted for Senior & U-23/U-22 players; borne by MPCA for junior teams.
Refreshments on practice days between matches allowed reasonably.
Summer extras (lemon water, chaach, ice) and night ground-staff food allowed reasonably.
Coach & trainer profiles must be submitted in advance.
Hon. Secretary's endorsement required on all claim documents.
Office Bearers may allow minor variation in pax/charges at discretion.

schemes.name: Inter-Club 'A' Grade Tournament Reimbursement
schemes.description: Reimbursement for hosting Inter-Club 'A' Grade tournaments (2-day matches only).
conditions: Maximum 10–12 'A'-grade clubs (based on 10-point ranking guideline).
2-day matches ONLY; no one-day; no league-cum-knockout.
Only competitive clubs participate.
Local conveyance is the club's own responsibility.
Coach, trainer, manager fees are NOT sanctioned under this scheme.
Prize money paid by bank transfer to club's account only.
Prize money forfeited if not claimed within 6 months.
TDS applicable on prize money.
Scores of all matches to be provided to MPCA.
required_documents: Bank transfer details for prize money

schemes.name: Inter-Divisional Tournament — Officials' Match Fees, Conveyance & DA
schemes.description: Fees, conveyance, and daily allowance for Selectors, Umpires, Scorers, and Observers in Inter-Divisional matches.

heads.label: Match Fee — Scorers (BCCI Panel, Multi-day / Ltd-over)

conditions: Applies to Selectors, Umpires, Scorers, and Observers.
Conveyance is for actual days including one day before.
DA is for outstation officials only.
Paid per scheduled match-day.

schemes.name: Periodical Coaching Camp for District Players
schemes.description: Coaching camps for district/rural players unable to access divisional guidance daily.

heads.label: Travel
heads.rate_display: Actual ordinary bus / SL rail fare

conditions: Duration: 2 weeks, once a year.
Two groups: up to 18 yrs and elder players.
Camp modelled on MPCA academy: daily 2 sessions, one weekly off.
Accommodation: triple occupancy only.
Not applicable for camps of Divisional teams before Inter-Divisional Tournament (use Scheme 3-D).
Inform MPCA in advance with player numbers, native places, and duration.
Division must issue a media release (news + photos) about the endeavour.
required_documents: Bills/vouchers & relevant supporting documents for expenditure

schemes.name: Vacation Camps
schemes.description: Coaching camps during summer vacation.

heads.label: Inter-city Travel
heads.rate_display: Actual ordinary bus / SL rail fare

conditions: Duration: 2–3 weeks (summer vacation).
Two groups: up to 18 yrs and elder players.
MPCA academy model: daily 2 sessions, one weekly off.
Accommodation: triple occupancy.
Divisional Secretary's undertaking required: no charges collected from players.
Claim form + bills/vouchers + undertaking required.
required_documents: Divisional Secretary's undertaking (no charges from players)

schemes.name: Pre-Tournament Camp for Divisional Teams
schemes.description: Camps for Divisional teams before Inter-Divisional Tournaments.

heads.label: Match Balls
heads.rate_display: Provided by MPCA for the camp

conditions: Camp duration max 8 days (including reporting & departure).
Team strength 18–20 players (typically 7–8 outstation).
Subsidy subject to actuals & documents.
If Division has more district players, subsidy adjusted based on accommodation (₹500/day/outstation player) + boarding (₹500/day/player).
Coach & trainer from MPCA empanelled list only.
If tournament postponed within 8–10 days and camp already scheduled, additional camp days allowed case-to-case.

schemes.name: Award for top District team in multi-day Inter-District Tournament
schemes.description: Monetary award for top-ranked District teams in MPCA Inter-District multi-day tournaments.
conditions: Award is for Districts other than the Divisional HQ team.
For Divisions with 5+ Districts: top 2 ranked teams receive awards.
For Divisions with ≤ 4 Districts: only the top 1 team receives an award.
If the HQ team wins, the finalist is treated as Rank 1; better-performing losing semi-finalist as Rank 2.

schemes.name: Coaching Grant for Districts
schemes.description: Annual grant to District Cricket Associations for coaching activities.
conditions: Split as: Up to ₹25,000 for conducting coaching camps at District level.
Split as: Up to ₹25,000 for coaches attending Inter-District tournaments.
Cannot be claimed if Scheme 1-A claim is not submitted accurately within 8–9 months of the previous FY closure.

schemes.name: Administrative Grant for Districts
schemes.description: Annual grant to District Cricket Associations for basic administrative purposes.
conditions: Cannot be claimed if Scheme 1-A claim is not submitted accurately within 8–9 months of the previous FY closure.

schemes.name: Scholarship for raw / untapped District players
schemes.description: Scholarship for promising District players not yet involved in Divisional activities.

heads.label: Scholarship for top 5 players in multi-day Inter-Divisional circuit
Scholarship for top 5 players in Women's Inter-Divisional circuit

conditions: Player must reside and be coached in Districts.
Player should not be a state team member or above.
Player must not be involved in any active activity at the Divisional HQ.

schemes.name: Benevolent Fund for Health Care (BFHC) — Players & Umpires
schemes.description: Reimbursement of medical expenses for major ailments to former players and umpires.
conditions: Covers treatment of major & serious ailments including hospitalization in India.
Does not cover medical aid, equipment, or gadgets.
Players: Played for India OR MP in Senior/Junior Domestic tournaments (min 6 years for juniors).
Umpires: BCCI Panel OR MPCA State Panel (min 10 years officiating).
Not payable if personal monthly income ≥ ₹35,000 or total immovable assets > ₹35 lacs (CA-certified).
Must exhaust benefits from other sources (BCCI, employer, insurance) first.
Applications must be received within 6 months of treatment commencement.
Beneficiary cannot be facing disciplinary action or involved in unsanctioned matches.

schemes.name: Apparels to State Team Players
schemes.description: Provision of comprehensive cricket apparels to players selected for MP State teams.
conditions: Provided before tournament/tour start.
Players must use the provided apparels for all appearances.
Includes team kit bag, playing & practice T-shirts/trousers/shorts, caps, sweaters, hoodie, track suit.

schemes.name: Performance Awards to Players / Teams / Umpires (BCCI & Domestic Circuit)
schemes.description: Awards for outstanding performance in BCCI and MPCA tournaments.

heads.label: Madhavrao Scindia Award — Best Senior Cricketer (Men's)
Madhavrao Scindia Award — Best Junior Cricketer (Men's)
Maharani Ushadevi Award — Best Senior Cricketer (Women's)
Chandra Nayudu Award — Best Junior Cricketer (Women's)
Best Spin Bowler in U-16 BCCI tournament
Best Fast Bowler in U-16 BCCI tournament
Narendra Hirwani Award — Best Spin Bowler in U-19 BCCI tournament
Ashok Jagdale Award — Best Fast Bowler in U-19 BCCI tournament
Ltd. Overs / T20 Trophy — WINNER (Players+Staff Pool)
Ltd. Overs / T20 Trophy — WINNER (Division Share)
Ltd. Overs / T20 Trophy — RUNNER-UP (Players+Staff Pool)
Ltd. Overs / T20 Trophy — RUNNER-UP (Division Share)
MY Memorial Trophy — Best Fielder / WK
H. Gaekwad Trophy — Best Fielder / WK
MM Jagdale Trophy — Best Fielder / WK
AW Kanmadikar Trophy — Best Fielder / WK
JS Anand Trophy — Best Fielder / WK

conditions: Team prize money distributed among players and support staff.
TDS applicable for Senior & U-23/U-22 groups; borne by MPCA for junior teams.
Awards to Best Spin & Fast bowlers subject to noteworthy performance.
Team prize money for BCCI tournaments decided by Managing Committee annually.
MPCA tournament prize money to be paid by bank transfer to club's account.

schemes.name: Incentive Scheme for Encouraging Outright Victories (Multi-Day Matches)
schemes.description: Incentives for outright victories in multi-day matches (BCCI and MPCA Inter-Divisional).

heads.label: Individual reward for scoring 100+ runs OR taking 5+ wickets
Ranji Trophy — League win by innings or 10 wkts
U-23 — League win by innings or 10 wkts
U-19 — League win by innings or 10 wkts
U-16 — League win by innings or 10 wkts
MPCA Open — League win by innings or 10 wkts
MPCA U-23 — League win by innings or 10 wkts
MPCA U-18 — League win by innings or 10 wkts
MPCA U-15 — League win by innings or 10 wkts

conditions: Applicable if team reaches knock-out/super-league stage of the tournament.
Distribution: Playing XI (75% pro-rata), Non-playing (15% pro-rata), Coach (4%), Other staff (6%).
TDS deducted for Senior & U-23/U-22; borne by MPCA for junior teams.
Additional rewards considered for exceptional individual performances.
League stage awards criteria: Wins against top-ranked teams; 75% for other wins (BCCI); 50% for other wins (MPCA).

schemes.name: MPCA Lifetime Achievement Awards
schemes.description: MPCA's highest annual award recognizing contributions to cricket in India and MP.

heads.label: C T Sarwate Award — On-Field Category

conditions: Maximum 2 awards per year (one for each category).
Usually one candidate per award; not shared as far as possible.
Awarded during the lifetime of the awardee — NOT posthumous.
Open for Men's or Women's cricket candidates.
No candidate facing punitive action from MPCA / BCCI is eligible.
Priority 1: Contribution to cricket in India; Priority 2: Contribution to cricket in MP/Madhya Bharat/Holkar.

schemes.name: MPCA Nishkaam Karmyogi Awards
schemes.description: Recognition for 'Unsung Heroes' supporting cricket with passionate involvement.
conditions: Awarded to industrious individuals supporting cricket with on-field/off-field activities.
Recognizes contributions with little or no glory/award-reward.
Awarded annually to 3 individuals.

schemes.name: Annual Incentive Scheme for Divisional Cricket Associations
schemes.description: Monetary incentive for top two Divisions based on multi-faceted performance parameters.
conditions: Based on cricket-oriented activities, player development, resource development efforts, administrative set-up, statutory compliances etc.
Parameters reviewed annually by CDC.
Divisions must submit supporting documents.

schemes.name: Ground Maintenance Equipment to Districts / Divisions
schemes.description: One-time allotment of ground equipment to Districts for grounds used for regular cricket activities.
conditions: Application in MPCA format, submitted by District President & Hon. Secretary, backed by committee resolution.
One set of equipment per ground/pitch category (turf OR matting) per District.
Only equipment not already available is provided; miscellaneous items may be bought locally with prior MPCA approval and reimbursed against invoice.
Ownership remains with MPCA; equipment may be pulled back if utility is unsatisfactory.
Original cost of unrecoverable items is recoverable from amounts due to District within 3 years.
required_documents: Satisfactory report from Divisional Secretary & CDC nominee

schemes.name: Computer & Peripherals for Divisional Office
schemes.description: Reimbursement for computer and peripherals for Divisional offices.
conditions: Applicable once in a span of 5–8 years.
Items reimbursed: All-in-One Desktop Computer (500 GB SSD, 8 GB RAM, i3 Processor, 20-22 inch screen), All-in-One Printer (Print/Copy/Scan), UPS (15-20 min backup).
Procure consolidated rates (quotation) from an established service provider.
Include charges for annual maintenance after warranty.
MPCA issues PO after confirmation; payment is direct to vendor after delivery and endorsement by Division's Secretary.
required_documents: Original invoice endorsed by Division Secretary

schemes.name: Annual Grant for Engaging Office Staff (Divisional Office)
schemes.description: Grant for engaging office and cricket staff in Divisional offices.

heads.label: Cost towards other office expenses (stationery etc.)

conditions: Division must inform MPCA of individuals handling Accounts/office work and Cricket activities.
Covering letter mentioning qualifications of individuals.
Employment/assignment letter copy required, detailing scope of work, hours, leave, emoluments, joining date, probation.
Monetary consideration must not be less than minimum wages.
Claim periodicity: Half-yearly (April & October).
Payment to staff strictly by cheque; bank statement copy required.
required_documents: Monthly attendance register (signed by staff & supervisor)
Photocopy of bank statement highlighting payments
Supportings for office expenses (certified by Secretary/office bearer)

schemes.name: Subsidy for Ground Maintenance (Divisional Cricket Association)
schemes.description: Subsidy for upkeep of cricket grounds managed by Divisional Cricket Associations.
conditions: Maximum 2 grounds per Division covered.
Division must provide assurance of continued use for Divisional/BCCI matches for min. 3 years.
Ground must be approved by the CDC.
If ground not provided for MPCA purposes, grant discontinued & previous 3 years' grant recoverable.
5% annual increment subject to satisfactory performance (w.e.f. FY 2025-26).
Payment to staff strictly by cheque; bank statement copy required.
Claim documentation includes attendance, employment letters, and expense supportings.
required_documents: List of grounds regularly used for Divisional/BCCI matches
Written assurance for min. 3 years use
Photocopy of bank statement highlighting payments to staff
Copy of employment/assignment letter for staff

schemes.name: Monthly Benevolence Contribution Scheme (Men)
schemes.description: Monthly financial assistance for former First-Class cricketers and Umpires from MP not covered by similar BCCI/State schemes.

heads.label: Umpires — BCCI Panel (not covered by BCCI scheme)

conditions: Applicable only to former first-class cricketers / State-panel or BCCI-panel umpires NOT covered by similar schemes.
Beneficiary entitled under only ONE category (player or umpire, whichever is higher).
Players must have played for Holkar/MP, retired from first-class cricket, and be 40+ years of age (since Sep 2017).
Umpires must have crossed 55 years of age and retired from umpiring.
Scheme ceases on the life of the beneficiary; not applicable posthumously.
Late-enrolment cut-off: No benefits prior to enrolment date (w.e.f. 01.01.2022).
Revised provisions w.e.f. 01.04.2025: Players with >24 FC matches NOT entitled. Players eligible after 50 years (or 60 if employed). International/IPL players eligible after 60 years.
Revised provisions w.e.f. 01.04.2025: Umpires inducted into State Panel after this date NOT eligible. Employed umpires eligible after 60 years.
Scheme reviewed annually and can be discontinued.

schemes.name: Hosting Fees & Participation Subsidy (BCCI)
schemes.description: Fees paid by BCCI to Host Associations and subsidy paid to visiting teams' State Associations.

heads.label: Hosting Fee — All multi-day RED-ball tournaments
Hosting Fee — Limited-overs WHITE-ball tournaments (50 overs & T20)
Hosting Fee — Limited-overs WHITE-ball tournaments UNDER LIGHTS
Participation Subsidy — All multi-day RED-ball tournaments
Participation Subsidy — All limited-overs WHITE-ball tournaments

conditions: Hosting fees paid by BCCI to Host.
Participation subsidy paid by BCCI to visiting team's State Association.
Host Association arranges local security at all match AND practice venues.
Host provides at least 2 practice sessions of 3 hours each per team.
Match balls are arranged & sent by BCCI.
BCCI provides Winner/Runner-up medals.
State teams must use State-Association-provided clothing with NAME & NUMBER.

schemes.name: Match Operations — Security, Reporting, Squad & Match Conditions (BCCI)
schemes.description: BCCI guidelines on match operations, including security, practice, squad size, and match conditions.

heads.label: Squad Size (Max Players in Dressing Room)

conditions: Security personnel at all match AND practice venues.
At least 2 practice sessions of 3 hours each per team.
Max 15 players + 10 support staff per squad.
Playing XI gets 100% match fee; remaining 4 players get 50%.
Team India cricketer deputed by BCCI eligible for match fee above 15-player limit.
Match Playing Conditions covered in a separate BCCI document.
Host MUST provide at least one practice session under lights for relevant tournaments.
BCCI provides Winner/Runner-up medals.
All State teams must wear State-Association-provided clothing with NAME & NUMBER.

schemes.name: Match Balls Specifications (BCCI)
schemes.description: Specifications for match balls used in BCCI Domestic Tournaments.
conditions: Match balls are arranged & sent by BCCI to all Host Associations.
Host does not procure balls.
Specific ball types (SG Test LE Red/White, Kookaburra Turf White) mandated for different men's & women's tournaments.

schemes.name: Venue Infrastructure Requirements (BCCI)
schemes.description: Mandatory infrastructure requirements for venues staging BCCI tournaments.

heads.label: Physiotherapy / Massage Tables
heads.rate_display: At least 2 tables for visiting teams

conditions: Camera structure must be stable and firm (Front-fix 30ft, Side-camera 12ft).
One 500 kg AND one 750 kg roller per ground.
Ground covers for main square AND bowling run-ups both ends.
One Super Sopper per ground.
Sight screen minimum dimensions: 20 × 60 ft.
Dressing rooms must have attached toilets & showers, space for kit bags.
Sufficient ice supplied by Host for ice baths.
Separate Men's & Women's washrooms within PMOA for women's matches.
Dedicated buffet-dining area within PMOA.
Anti-doping room must have attached toilet and be available on all match & practice days.
NADA officials collect samples; testing plan is confidential.

schemes.name: Visiting Team Hospitality & Logistics (BCCI)
schemes.description: BCCI guidelines on hotel accommodation, medical, transport, catering, and TLO for visiting teams.
conditions: Host Association helps teams book hotels of their choice.
Host may tentatively block rooms for knock-out stages.
Match Officials' hotel invoices borne by BCCI; Team members' by State Association.
Doctor on site, ambulance with 2+ paramedics, and tie-up with nearest hospital (green corridor) mandatory on all match & practice days.
Host makes ALL transport arrangements: 45-seater luxury coach, baggage van, team manager Innova, officials Innova.
Catering includes buffet meals, tea/coffee, fruits; food boxes for ground staff; sufficient bottled water.
Dedicated TLO per team coordinates arrival/departure, accreditation, ground transfers, catering.
Separate Liaison Officer for match officials.

schemes.name: Accreditation, Anti-Corruption, Media & General (BCCI)
schemes.description: BCCI guidelines on accreditation, anti-corruption measures, media access, and general notes.
conditions: Participating teams prepare accreditation cards.
Host Association prepares signage per anti-corruption guidelines, including headshot boards.
BCCI Anti-Corruption Officials provide guidance.
Media allowed only in dedicated Media Enclosure.
Selectors not part of squad stay in team hotel at State Association's expense; Host provides separate seating.
Basic hygiene & sanitisation of dressing rooms and common areas to be maintained.
One ACLO (Anti-Corruption Liaison Officer) appointed by Host per venue.
BCCI reserves the right to amend guidelines at any time.
